## Biography

An open cluster in the Orion region — young stars, bright nebulosity, the kind of stellar nursery that produces both beauty and radiation hazards. The Fimbulthul joined the Distant Worlds 3 flotilla here in January 3312, beginning the four-month trek toward the galactic frontier.

For pilots, the NGC 1981 Cluster is a waypoint. For the DW3 expedition, it was the starting line. The "Shoulder of Orion" colonisation initiative had already sent Trailblazers through this area, scouting routes around the permit-locked COL 70 sector. The cluster's proximity to Barnard's Loop makes it a natural gathering point for expeditions heading rimward. Its youth — in astronomical terms — means the stars burn hot and the navigation is tricky. Perfect for an expedition that wanted to test both ships and crews before the real darkness began.
